name: generate
title: Generate
description: UUIDs, passwords, passphrases, random numbers, hashes, encodings, lorem ipsum, colours and QR codes, and a JWT taken apart. Every value copies on Enter.
author: pal

settings.label: Password length
settings.description: Characters in a generated password; `password 32` in the panel overrides it for one listing.

settings.label: Password characters
settings.description: What a password is drawn from; a word after `password` (`password 16 alnum`) overrides it for one listing.

settings.label: Passphrase words
settings.description: Words in a passphrase, from a list of 2551 common five-letter words (about 11 bits each); `passphrase 7` overrides it for one listing.

store.tagline: UUIDs, passwords, hashes, base64, lorem ipsum, QR codes and JWTs
features: A fresh value of everything before you type: UUID v4 and v7, ULID, Nano ID, a password, a passphrase, random bytes, lorem ipsum, a colour
A word and a number narrow it: `password 32 alnum`, `passphrase 7`, `number 1-6`, `lorem 3 paragraphs`
Hash or encode the text you type, or the clipboard: `sha256`, `md5`, `base64`, `url`, `hex`, `decode`
`qr <text>` draws a QR code; `cmd+c` copies it as SVG
`jwt <token>` shows the header, the payload and when it expires (the signature is not checked)
`enter` copies, `cmd+enter` pastes into the app in front, `cmd+r` makes new values

screenshots.caption: The empty query: a fresh value of every generator, the secrets with their strength and entropy
hash of typed text: all four digests, and Copy all on cmd+shift+c
qr of a link: the code on the row and large in the detail pane
jwt: the header, the payload with its expiry, the times, and a reminder that nothing is verified
password 24: the password as the answer; the pane has its strength, length and entropy
